437.description: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. One caused a news stir when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2000-year sleep.

438.name: Bonsly
438.description: Bonsly prefers an arid atmosphere. In order to adjust the level of fluids in its body, it exudes water from its eyes. This makes it appear to be crying.

439.name: Mime Jr.
439.description: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy's movements. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.

440.name: Happiny
440.description: It carries a round white rock in its belly pouch. If it gets along well with someone, it will sometimes give that person the rock.

441.name: Chatot
441.description: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it's one of them. This way they won't attack it. It can also learn and speak human words.

442.name: Spiritomb
442.description: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

443.name: Gible
443.description: It nests in horizontal holes warmed by geothermal heat. Foes who stray too close can expect to be pounced on and bitten.

444.name: Gabite
444.description: Shiny objects are its passion. It can be found in its cave, scarcely moving, its gaze fixed on the jewels it's amassed or Carbink it has caught.

445.name: Garchomp
445.description: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It is covered in fine scales that reduce drag, enabling it to fly at high speeds.

446.name: Munchlax
446.description: When it finds something that looks like it might be edible, it goes right ahead and swallows it whole. That's why it gets fatter day by day.

447.name: Riolu
447.description: It can discern the physical and emotional states of people, Pokémon, and other natural things from the shape of their aura waves.

448.name: Lucario
448.description: It understands human speech. It is said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect Auras. Even foes it could not otherwise see.

449.name: Hippopotas
449.description: Hippopotas shuts its nostrils tight when travelling through sand. Instead of perspiration, it expels grains of sand from its body.

450.name: Hippowdon
450.description: It is surprisingly quick to anger. It brandishes its gaping mouth in a display of fearsome strength and raises vast quantities of sand while attacking.

451.name: Skorupi
451.description: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes. It can survive a year without food.

452.name: Drapion
452.description: Possessing a sturdy build, it takes pride in its strength. It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap out of a car.

453.name: Croagunk
453.description: Croagunk rarely fights fairly. Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

454.name: Toxicroak
454.description: Swaying and dodging the attacks of its foes, it weaves its flexible body in close, then lunges out with its poisonous claws.

455.name: Carnivine
455.description: Hanging from branches using its tentacles, it looks like a plant. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down.

456.name: Finneon
456.description: Its double tail fins propel its energetic jumps. When it breaks the surface of the sea, Wingull swoop down to grab it on the fly.

457.name: Lumineon
457.description: Lumineon swimming in the darkness of the deep sea look like stars shining in the night sky. It competes for food with Lanturn.

458.name: Mantyke
458.description: When it swims close to the surface of the ocean, people aboard ships are able to observe the pattern on its back. It often swims in a school of Remoraid.

459.name: Snover
459.description: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain's lower reaches. Seemingly curious about people, they gather around footsteps they find on snowy mountains.

460.name: Abomasnow
460.description: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as “The Ice Monster.”

461.name: Weavile
461.description: They travel in groups of four or five, leaving signs for one another on trees and rocks. They bring down their prey with coordinated attacks.

462.name: Magnezone
462.description: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin, while transmitting its own signals of unknown purpose.

463.name: Lickilicky
463.description: The long tongue is always soggy with slobber. The saliva contains a solvent that causes numbness. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.

464.name: Rhyperior
464.description: It can launch a rock held in its hand like a missile by tightening and then expanding its muscles instantaneously. Geodude are shot at rare times.

465.name: Tangrowth
465.description: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Even if one of its arms is eaten, it's fine. The Pokémon regenerates quickly and will go right back to normal.

466.name: Electivire
466.description: When it gets excited, it thumps its chest. With every thud, thunder roars, electric sparks shower all around and blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.

467.name: Magmortar
467.description: According to what is known, a single pair of male and female Magmortar lives in one volcano. From its arm, it launches fireballs hotter than 3,600ºF.

468.name: Togekiss
468.description: As everyone knows, it visits peaceful regions, bringing them gifts of kindness and sweet blessings. It will never appear where there is strife.

469.name: Yanmega
469.description: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. It is adept at biting apart foes while flying by at high speed.

470.name: Leafeon
470.description: Its cellular composition is closer to that of a plant than an animal. It uses photosynthesis to produce its energy supply without eating food.

471.name: Glaceon
471.description: It can control its body temperature at will. This enables it to freeze the moisture in the atmosphere, creating flurries of diamond dust.

472.name: Gliscor
472.description: Gliscor observes prey while hanging upside down from branches. Its flight is soundless. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

473.name: Mamoswine
473.description: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. It woke up to much amazement. This Pokémon has been around for a long, long, long time.

474.name: Porygon-Z
474.description: In order to create a more advanced Pokémon, an additional program was installed, but apparently it contained a defect that made it move oddly.

475.name: Gallade
475.description: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows when trying to protect someone. It can sense what its foe is thinking.

476.name: Probopass
476.description: It freely controls three units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force. With them, it can attack its foes from three directions.

477.name: Dusknoir
477.description: This feared Pokémon is said to travel to worlds unknown. Some even believe that it takes lost spirits into its pliant body and guides them home.

478.name: Froslass
478.description: When it finds people or Pokémon it likes, it freezes them and takes them to its chilly den, where they become its decorations.

479.name: Rotom
479.description: Its body is composed of plasma and loves to surprise others. One boy's invention led to the development of many machines that can use of Rotom's unique capabilities.

480.name: Uxie
480.description: Known as ”The Being of Knowledge,” according to some sources, this Pokémon provided people with the intelligence necessary to solve various problems.

481.name: Mesprit
481.description: Although it slumbers at the bottom of a lake, its spirit is said to leave its body and flitter on the water surface. It taught humans of sorrow, pain, and joy.

482.name: Azelf
482.description: This Pokémon is said to have endowed humans with the determination needed to do things. It is thought that Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf all came from the same egg.

483.name: Dialga
483.description: A Pokémon spoken of in legend. It completely controls the flow of time. It uses its power to travel at will through the past and future.

484.name: Palkia
484.description: Palkia has the ability to distort space. Its total control over the boundaries of space enable it to transport itself to faraway places and other dimensions.

485.name: Heatran
485.description: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It dwells in volcanic caves, using its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

486.name: Regigigas
486.description: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon shaped Regirock, Regice, and Registeel out of clay, ice, and magma.

487.name: Giratina
487.description: This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange. It was banished for its violence.

488.name: Cresselia
488.description: Those who sleep holding one of Cresselia's feathers are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

489.name: Phione
489.description: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs. It always returns to where it was born.

490.name: Manaphy
490.description: Water makes up 80% of its body. It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

491.name: Darkrai
491.description: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers. However, it means no harm.

492.name: Shaymin
492.description: The flowers all over its body bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude. It dissolves toxins in the air to transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.

494.name: Victini
494.description: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

495.name: Snivy
495.description: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

496.name: Servine
496.description: When it gets dirty, its leaves can't be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps clean. They avoid attacks by sinking into the shadows of thick foliage.

497.name: Serperior
497.description: They raise their heads to intimidate foes, but only give it their all when fighting powerful opponents who are not fazed by the glare from its noble eyes.

498.name: Tepig
498.description: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp. It blows fire through its nose.

499.name: Pignite
499.description: The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. When it is angered, the intensity of the flame increases.

500.name: Emboar
500.description: It is adept at using many different moves. It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

501.name: Oshawott
501.description: The scalchop on its stomach isn't just used for battle, it can be used to break open hard berries as well. It is made from the same element as its claws.

502.name: Dewott
502.description: Strict training and disclipine leads it to master its flowing double-scalchop technique. Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another.

503.name: Samurott
503.description: One swing of the seamitars attached to its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them is enough to intimidate most enemies.

504.name: Patrat
504.description: Extremely cautious, they take shifts to maintain a constant watch of their nest. Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days.

505.name: Watchog
505.description: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents. Keen eyesight lets them see in the dark.

506.name: Lillipup
506.description: It faces strong opponents with great courage. Because it doesn't yelp, it's extremely popular with Trainers who live in apartment buildings.

507.name: Herdier
507.description: Its dense black fur grows continuously. The high cost of keeping its hard fur properly groomed makes this a troublesome Pokémon to train.

508.name: Stoutland
508.description: Intelligent, good-natured, and valiant, there could be no concern that it would ever attack people. Some parents even trust it to babysit.

509.name: Purrloin
509.description: Their deceptively cute act is the perfect ruse. They steal from people for fun, but their victims can't help but forgive them.

510.name: Liepard
510.description: Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur. These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. They run silently in the night.

511.name: Pansage
511.description: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. It's good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It's kind enough to share them with friends.

512.name: Simisage
512.description: Ill tempered, it attacks enemies by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

513.name: Pansear
513.description: The fire within the tuft on its head can reach up to 600ºF. Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.

514.name: Simisear
514.description: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

515.name: Panpour
515.description: The water stored inside the tuft of its head is rich in nutrients. It waters plants using its tail, plants that receive its water grow large.

516.name: Simipour
516.description: It can shoot highly-pressurised water from its tail with enough power to break through a solid concrete wall. It prefers places with clean water.

517.name: Munna
517.description: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams. Munna always float in the air.

518.name: Musharna
518.description: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon. It changes into different colors depending on the dream that was eaten.

519.name: Pidove
519.description: This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for a new order from its Trainer even though it already has one. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.

520.name: Tranquill
520.description: No matter where in the world it goes, it knows where its nest is, so it can always return to its Trainer's location regardless of the distance.

521.name: Unfezant
521.description: Males have plumage on their heads. The females' flying abilities surpass those of the males. They will only let themselves feel close to their Trainers.

522.name: Blitzle
522.description: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate with one another.

523.name: Zebstrika
523.description: When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates. It is dangerous when it's angry as it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

524.name: Roggenrola
524.description: The hexagonal cavity is its ear. It walks in the direction of sounds it hears, but if the sounds cease, it panics and topples over.

525.name: Boldore
525.description: Its orange crystal is a mass of energy. Just one crystal fragment would provide enough fuel for a hundred dump trucks. When it is healthy, its core sticks out.

526.name: Gigalith
526.description: The blasts of energy it makes from sunbeams have terrifying power. However, it's not able to fire its blasts at night or on rainy days.

527.name: Woobat
527.description: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. Suction from its nostrils enables it to stick to cave walls during sleep. It leaves a heart-shaped mark behind.

528.name: Swoobat
528.description: Anyone who comes into contact with the ultrasonic waves emitted by a courting male experiences a positive mood shift.

529.name: Drilbur
529.description: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph by spinning its body. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

530.name: Excadrill
530.description: More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels, but it can also help with construction.

531.name: Audino
531.description: Its auditory sense is astounding. Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.

532.name: Timburr
532.description: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs. As they grow, they carry bigger logs.

533.name: Gurdurr
533.description: They strengthen their bodies by carrying steel beams. This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

534.name: Conkeldurr
534.description: They use concrete pillars as walking canes. Rather than rely solely on force, they master moves that utilize the centrifugal force of spinning concrete.

535.name: Tympole
535.description: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk and warns others of danger.

536.name: Palpitoad
536.description: It lives in the water and on land. When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

537.name: Seismitoad
537.description: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. They can also shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps.

538.name: Throh
538.description: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts. It changes belts as it gets more powerful.

539.name: Sawk
539.description: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train. Disturbing their training angers them.

540.name: Sewaddle
540.description: It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth. Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes, it is a mascot for fashion designers.

541.name: Swadloon
541.description: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

542.name: Leavanny
542.description: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to weave warm wrappings for Sewaddle by using the silk secreted from its mouth.

543.name: Venipede
543.description: Using the feelers on its head and tail, it picks up vibrations in the air to determine its prey's location and state. It is brutally aggressive.

544.name: Whirlipede
544.description: Storing energy for evolution, it sits. But when attacked, it spins its body at high speed like a wheel and then crashes furiously into its opponent.

545.name: Scolipede
545.description: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails. Then it finishes them off with deadly poison.

546.name: Cottonee
546.description: When it finds others of its kind, they all stick together. When enough of them have collected, the mass resembles a cumulonimbus cloud.

547.name: Whimsicott
547.description: It rides on the wind and slips into people's homes. After it has turned a room into a cotton-filled mess, it giggles to itself and takes off.

548.name: Petilil
548.description: By pruning the leaves on its head with regularity, this Pokémon can be grown into a fine plump shape. These bitter leaves refresh those who eat them.

549.name: Lilligant
549.description: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. It withers away if a trainer does not take good care of it.

550.name: Basculin
550.description: It used to be a common food source. The meat of red Basculin is on the fatty side and it's more popular with the youth. Its temperament is vicious and aggressive.

551.name: Sandile
551.description: It conceals itself in the sand and chomps down on the legs of any prey that unwarily walk over it. Its favorite food is Trapinch.

552.name: Krokorok
552.description: They move in groups of a few individuals. Thanks to the special membrane covering its eyes, it can see its surroundings clearly, even in the dead of night.

553.name: Krookodile
553.description: Very violent Pokémon, they never allow their prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

554.name: Darumaka
554.description: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it pulls its limbs into its body and falls asleep.

555.name: Darmanitan
555.description: When one is injured in a fierce battle, it transforms into a stone statue. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind and fights on mentally.

556.name: Maractus
556.description: Arid regions are their habitat. When it moves rhythmically, it makes a sound similar to maracas, making the surprised Pokémon flee.

557.name: Dwebble
557.description: It makes a hole in a stone of a suitable size. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.

558.name: Crustle
558.description: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle and begins to weaken.

559.name: Scraggy
559.description: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck. Its skull is massively thick.

560.name: Scrafty
560.description: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. The one with the biggest crest is the group leader, and is the most respected.

561.name: Sigilyph
561.description: The guardians of an ancient city, they always fly the same route while keeping watch for invaders. They use their psychic power to attack enemies.

562.name: Yamask
562.description: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves in past ages. Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human.

563.name: Cofagrigus
563.description: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies. Their bodies are covered in pure gold.

564.name: Tirtouga
564.description: Reputed to be the ancestor of most turtle Pokémon, it lived in warm seas about a hundred million years ago. It was restored from a fossil.

565.name: Carracosta
565.description: They can live both in the ocean and on land. Incredible jaw strength enables them to chew up steel beams and rocks along with their prey.

566.name: Archen
566.description: Said to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon, Archen itself could not actually fly but moved by hopping from treetop to treetop.

567.name: Archeops
567.description: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. When one Archeops had the prey cornered, another would swoop on it.

568.name: Trubbish
568.description: It gorges on trash until its stomach is full. Then it belches toxic gas. An unlucky whiff of this gas will put a person in the hospital.

569.name: Garbodor
569.description: Beware the poisonous liquid it shoots from its right arm. If even a little of it gets on you, you'll experience the full effects of this unidentified toxin.

570.name: Zorua
570.description: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

571.name: Zoroark
571.description: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents. They defend their lair with illusory scenery.

572.name: Minccino
572.description: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.

573.name: Cinccino
573.description: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Cinccino's body is coated in a special oil that repels dust and helps it deflect attacks, such as punches.

574.name: Gothita
574.description: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, Gothita are looking at something that only they can see. Their ribbonlike feelers increase their power.

575.name: Gothorita
575.description: Starlight is the source of their power. They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading them astray are told in every corner.

576.name: Gothitelle
576.description: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power. When it learns its Trainer's life span, it cries in sadness.

577.name: Solosis
577.description: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they are fine in any environment, no matter how severe. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

578.name: Duosion
578.description: When their brains, now divided in two, are thinking the same thoughts, these Pokémon exhibit their maximized psychic power.

579.name: Reuniclus
579.description: They use psychic power to control their arms, which are made of a special liquid. When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains.

580.name: Ducklett
580.description: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

581.name: Swanna
581.description: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles. The one in the middle is the leader of the flock.

582.name: Vanillite
582.description: The temperature of their breath is -58ºF. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them. Vanillite is treasured by households in warm regions.

583.name: Vanillish
583.description: Vanillish has existed since the Ice Age. It controls particles of ice, freezes its opponents, and then shatters them with a headbutt.

584.name: Vanilluxe
584.description: Each of its two heads has a brain, and when they are in agreement, it attacks its enemies by exhaling a violent blizzard. It makes snow clouds inside its body.

585.name: Deerling
585.description: Deerling have different scents depending on the season. In early spring, these Pokémon give off a delicate, sweet, and calming scent.

586.name: Sawsbuck
586.description: Some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring because the plants growing on its horns change according to the season. The leader possesses magnificent horns.

587.name: Emolga
587.description: It glides using its cape-like membrane. It grills berries and bug Pokémon with electric shocks from the pouches on its cheeks and makes a meal of them.

588.name: Karrablast
588.description: When they feel threatened, they spit an acidic liquid to drive attackers away. For some reason they evolve while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

589.name: Escavalier
589.description: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances. The steel armor protects their whole body.

590.name: Foongus
590.description: It lures Pokémon in with its pattern that looks just like a Poké Ball, then releases its poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.

591.name: Amoonguss
591.description: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.

592.name: Frillish
592.description: If its veil-like arms stun and wrap an opponent, that foe will be dragged five miles below the surface to its lair, never to return.

593.name: Jellicent
593.description: They propel themselves by expelling absorbed seawater from their bodies. It's said there's a castle of ships Jellicent have sunk on the seafloor.

594.name: Alomomola
594.description: When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore. The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.

595.name: Joltik
595.description: Since they can't generate their own electricity, they attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in a pouch.

596.name: Galvantula
596.description: It creates barriers from electrified silk that stun foes. This works as a weapon as well as a defense. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.

597.name: Ferroseed
597.description: It absorbs the iron it finds in the rock while clinging to the ceiling of caves. When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes.

598.name: Ferrothorn
598.description: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers and shooting spikes. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.

599.name: Klink
599.description: Two bodies comprise a fixed pair. The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

600.name: Klang
600.description: A minigear and big gear comprise its body. Spinning minigears are rotated at high speed and repeatedly fired away. It is dangerous if the gears don't return.

601.name: Klinklang
601.description: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.

602.name: Tynamo
602.description: These Pokémon move in schools. One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

603.name: Eelektrik
603.description: These Pokémon have a big appetite. It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.

604.name: Eelektross
604.description: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean, with their sucker mouths.

605.name: Elgyem
605.description: It psychically squeezes the brain of its foe, causing unendurable headaches. Rumors of its origin are linked to a UFO crash site in the desert 50 years ago.

606.name: Beheeyem
606.description: It can manipulate an opponent's memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three fingers, but those patterns haven't been decoded.

607.name: Litwick
607.description: While Litwick shines a light and pretends to be a guide, it absorbs the life force of any who follow it, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

608.name: Lampent
608.description: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen. The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire.

609.name: Chandelure
609.description: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.

610.name: Axew
610.description: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly, harder and sturdier than the last.

611.name: Fraxure
611.description: Their tusks can shatter rocks. A broken tusk will not grow back, so it diligently sharpens its tusks on river rocks after the end of a battle.

612.name: Haxorus
612.description: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams.

613.name: Cubchoo
613.description: Its nose is always running. Their snot is a barometer of health. When healthy, their snot is sticky and the power of their ice moves increases.

614.name: Beartic
614.description: It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.

615.name: Cryogonal
615.description: They are born in snow clouds. When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes. When its temperature lowers, it returns to ice.

616.name: Shelmet
616.description: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It evolves when bathed in an electric-like energy along with Karrablast.

617.name: Accelgor
617.description: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in layers of thin membrane. It is very light and fights with ninja-like movements.

618.name: Stunfisk
618.description: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

619.name: Mienfoo
619.description: They have mastered elegant combos. As they concentrate, their battle moves become swifter and more precise. What it lacks in power, it makes up for in quantity.

620.name: Mienshao
620.description: They use the long fur on their arms as a whip to strike their opponents. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

621.name: Druddigon
621.description: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move. It uses its sharp claws to catch prey.

622.name: Golett
622.description: These Pokémon are thought to have been created by the science of an ancient and mysterious civilization. It's been active for thousands of years.

623.name: Golurk
623.description: Golurk were created to protect people and Pokémon by an ancient civilisation. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.

624.name: Pawniard
624.description: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey. If battling dulls them, it sharpens them on stones by the river.

625.name: Bisharp
625.description: This pitiless Pokémon commands a group of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.

626.name: Bouffalant
626.description: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.

627.name: Rufflet
627.description: With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierces its prey, and then it pecks at them. Although it also consumes berries, it's a carnivore at heart.

628.name: Braviary
628.description: For the sake of its friends, this brave warrior of the sky will not stop battling, even if it is injured. One can carry a car while flying.

629.name: Vullaby
629.description: It can't fly yet and must wait until its wings have developed more. They guard their posteriors with bones that were gathered by Mandibuzz.

630.name: Mandibuzz
630.description: They adorn themselves beautifully with bones. This is supposedly an effort to attract males, but no male Mandibuzz have ever been found.

631.name: Heatmor
631.description: It draws in air through its tail, transforms it into fire, and uses it like a tongue. They burn through Durant's steel bodies and consume their insides.

632.name: Durant
632.description: Durant dig nests in mountains. Individuals each play different roles in driving Heatmor, their natural predator, away from their colony.

633.name: Deino
633.description: Lacking sight, it's unaware of its surroundings, so it bumps into things and eats anything that moves. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.

634.name: Zweilous
634.description: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves on to another area. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.

635.name: Hydreigon
635.description: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

636.name: Larvesta
636.description: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. It spews fire from its horns and encases itself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves.

637.name: Volcarona
637.description: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it appeared and saved Pokémon from freezing, Volcarona's fire provided a replacement for the sun.

638.name: Cobalion
638.description: It has a body and heart of steel. This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.

639.name: Terrakion
639.description: Spoken of in legend, this Pokémon used its phenomenal power to destroy a castle in its effort to protect Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.

640.name: Virizion
640.description: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Legends say this Pokémon used whirlwind-like movements to confound and swiftly cut its opponents.

641.name: Tornadus
641.description: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power can blow entire houses away. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

642.name: Thundurus
642.description: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. Countless charred remains mar the landscape of places through which Thundurus has passed.

643.name: Reshiram
643.description: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it. It helps those who want to build a world of truth.

644.name: Zekrom
644.description: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with lightning. It has a generator that creates electricity in its tail. It assists those with strong ideals.

645.name: Landorus
645.description: The energy that comes pouring from its tail increases the nutrition in the soil, granting bountiful crops. It has been hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”

646.name: Kyurem
646.description: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals. Its body became frozen when its energy leaked out.

647.name: Keldeo
647.description: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers.

648.name: Meloetta
648.description: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad. Many famous songs have been inspired by the tunes that Meloetta plays.

650.name: Chespin
650.description: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock without any effort.

651.name: Quilladin
651.description: They strengthen the sturdy shell covering their bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won't start fights, but will counterattack with sharp quills.

652.name: Chesnaught
652.description: It shields its allies from danger with its own body. When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it can withstand a bomb blast.

653.name: Fennekin
653.description: As it walks, it munches on a twig to fill itself with energy in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its roomy ears.

654.name: Braixen
654.description: Braixen has a twig stuck in its tail. When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

655.name: Delphox
655.description: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future. It uses psychic power to incinerate its foes.

656.name: Froakie
656.description: It protects its skin by covering its body in bubbles it secretes from its chest and back. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

657.name: Frogadier
657.description: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away. Frogadier's swiftness is unparalleled.

658.name: Greninja
658.description: A wild Greninja in the world.

659.name: Bunnelby
659.description: It has ears like shovels. Digging holes strengthens its ears so much that they can sever thick roots effortlessly. Bunnelby dig the whole night through.

660.name: Diggersby
660.description: With its powerful ears it reduces dense bedrock to rubble. It can be a big help at construction sites. When it's finished digging, it lounges about lazily.

661.name: Fletchling
661.description: This amiable Pokémon is easy to train. But when battle is joined, it shows its ferocious side. It's merciless to intruders that enter its territory.

662.name: Fletchinder
662.description: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on any bewildered Pokémon that pop out of the grass.

663.name: Talonflame
663.description: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air. It finishes its prey off with a colossal kick.

666.name: Vivillon Icy Snow
666.description: A wild Vivillon Icy Snow in the world.

667.name: Litleo
667.description: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick to start a fight.

668.name: Pyroar
668.description: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride. The females protect the pride's cubs. They viciously threaten any challenger.

669.name: Flabebe Red
669.description: A wild Flabebe Red in the world.

670.name: Floette Red
670.description: A wild Floette Red in the world.

671.name: Florges Red
671.description: A wild Florges Red in the world.

672.name: Skiddo
672.description: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn't need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back. It has a placid disposition.

673.name: Gogoat
673.description: It can tell how its trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathetic sense lets them run as if one being. They inhabit mountainous regions.

674.name: Pancham
674.description: There's no point to the leaf in its mouth, aside from an effort to look cool. It's mischievous, so it's not well suited to inexperienced Trainers.

675.name: Pangoro
675.description: It boasts superb physical strength. Those who wish to become Pangoro's Trainer have no choice but to converse with their fists.

677.name: Espurr
677.description: It has enough psychic energy to blast everything within 300 feet of itself. The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears.

678.name: Meowstic
678.description: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It's when they're protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.

679.name: Honedge
679.description: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and drains that person's life energy completely.

680.name: Doublade
680.description: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords. The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even against those skilled at swordplay.

681.name: Aegislash
681.description: In this defensive stance, Aegislash uses its steel body and a force field of spectral power to reduce the damage of any attack.

682.name: Spritzee
682.description: In the past, rather than using perfume, royal ladies carried a Spritzee that would waft a fragrance they liked. Its fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.

683.name: Aromatisse
683.description: Its scent is so overpowering that, unless a Trainer happens to really enjoy the smell, he or she will have a hard time walking alongside it.

684.name: Swirlix
684.description: Because it eats nothing but sweets, its fur is as sticky sweet as cotton candy. To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes sticky white threads.

685.name: Slurpuff
685.description: Slurpuff can distinguish even the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

686.name: Inkay
686.description: It flashes the light-emitting spots on its body, which drains its opponent's will to fight. It takes the opportunity to scuttle away and hide.

687.name: Malamar
687.description: It lures prey close with hypnotic motions, then wraps its tentacles around it before finishing it off with digestive fluids. It forces others to do whatever it wants.

688.name: Binacle
688.description: They stretch and then contract, yanking their rocks along with them in bold hops. They eat seaweed that washes up on the shoreline.

689.name: Barbaracle
689.description: Barbaracle's legs and hands have minds of their own, and they will move independently. But they usually follow the head's orders.

690.name: Skrelp
690.description: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, it hides from foes while storing up power for its evolution. They spray liquid poison on prey that approach unawares.

691.name: Dragalge
691.description: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker. Tales are told of ships that wander into seas where Dragalge live, never to return.

692.name: Clauncher
692.description: Through controlled expulsions of internal gas, it can expel water like a pistol shot. At close distances, it can even shatter large rocks.

693.name: Clawitzer
693.description: By expelling water from the nozzle in the back of its enormous claw, it can move at a speed of 60 knots. They launch cannonballs made of water.

694.name: Helioptile
694.description: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their own energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

695.name: Heliolisk
695.description: A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper. It can stimulate its muscles with electricity, boosting the strength in its legs.

696.name: Tyrunt
696.description: Its immense jaws have enough destructive force that it can chew up a car. If something happens that it doesn't like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.

697.name: Tyrantrum
697.description: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.

698.name: Amaura
698.description: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years. It lived in a cold land where there were no predators.

699.name: Aurorus
699.description: Using the diamond-shaped crystals on its body it can instantly create a wall of ice to block an opponent's attack, or encase them in ice.

700.name: Sylveon
700.description: Its ribbonlike feelers give off an aura that weakens hostility in its prey, causing them to let down their guard. A moment later, it pounces.

701.name: Hawlucha
701.description: With its wings, it controls its position in the air. Its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.

702.name: Dedenne
702.description: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

703.name: Carbink
703.description: Born from the high temperatures and pressures deep underground, it defends itself by firing beams from the jewel part of its body.

704.name: Goomy
704.description: Its source of protection is its slimy, germ-laden mucous membrane. Anyone who touches it will need some thorough hand-washing.

705.name: Sliggoo
705.description: This Pokémon's mucous can dissolve anything. Toothless, it sprays mucous on its prey. Once they're nicely dissolved, it slurps them up.

706.name: Goodra
706.description: It gets picked on because it's meek. But then, whoever teased it gets to feel the full force of its horns and a good swatting from its thick tail.

707.name: Klefki
707.description: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them. It will sneak into people's homes to steal their keys.

708.name: Phantump
708.description: According to legend, medicine to cure any illness can be made by plucking the green leaves on its head, brewing them, and boiling down the liquid.

709.name: Trevenant
709.description: Through its roots, it exerts control over other trees. A deadly curse falls upon anyone cutting down trees in forests where Trevenant dwell.

710.name: Pumpkaboo
710.description: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

711.name: Gourgeist
711.description: Eerie cries emanate from its body in the dead of night. The sounds are said to be the wails of spirits who are suffering in the afterlife.

712.name: Bergmite
712.description: It blocks opponents' attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any cracks with new ice. They live in herds on snowy mountains.

713.name: Avalugg
713.description: The way several Bergmite huddle on its back make it look like an aircraft carrier made of ice. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.

714.name: Noibat
714.description: They live in pitch-black caves. Even a robust wrestler will become dizzy and unable to stand when exposed to its 200,000-hertz ultrasonic waves.

715.name: Noivern
715.description: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. The ultrasonic waves it emits from its ears can reduce a large boulder to pebbles.

716.name: Xerneas
716.description: A wild Xerneas in the world.

717.name: Yveltal
717.description: When its life comes to an end, its wings and tail spread wide and glow red, and it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon.

718.name: Zygarde
718.description: A wild Zygarde in the world.

719.name: Diancie
719.description: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world. It creates diamonds between its hands.

720.name: Hoopa
720.description: In its true form, it possess a huge amount of power. When its powers are sealed away, it is transformed into a much smaller form. It teleports things to a secret place.

721.name: Volcanion
721.description: It lets out billows of steam from the arms on its back and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

722.name: Rowlet
722.description: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night. Silently it glides, drawing near to its target.

723.name: Dartrix
723.description: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.

724.name: Decidueye
724.description: Decidueye is cool and cautious. It fires arrow quills from its wings with such precision, they can pierce a pebble at distances of over a hundred yards.

725.name: Litten
725.description: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

726.name: Torracat
726.description: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire. With a single punch, it can bend an iron bar right over.

727.name: Incineroar
727.description: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it's not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer's orders with complete nonchalance.

728.name: Popplio
728.description: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It practices diligently so it can learn to make big bubbles.

729.name: Brionne
729.description: It cares deeply for its companions. When its Trainer is feeling down, it performs a cheery dance with a sequence of water balloons to try and help.

730.name: Primarina
730.description: It controls its water balloons with song. The melody is learned from others of its kind and is passed down from one generation to the next.

731.name: Pikipek
731.description: This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for the attacks it fires off from its mouth. It uses holes in trees for nesting.

732.name: Trumbeak
732.description: By bending its beak, it can produce a variety of calls and brand itself a noisy nuisance for its neighbors. It eats berries and stores their seeds in its beak.

733.name: Toucannon
733.description: When it battles, within its beak, its internal gases ignite, explosively launching seeds with enough power to pulverize boulders.

734.name: Yungoos
734.description: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It wanders around in a never-ending search for food. At dusk, it collapses and falls asleep on the spot.

735.name: Gumshoos
735.description: A wild Gumshoos in the world.

736.name: Grubbin
736.description: They often gather near places frequented by electric Pokémon in order to avoid being attacked by bird Pokémon, though it normally lives underground.

737.name: Charjabug
737.description: From the food it digests, it generates electricity, and it stores this energy in its electric sac. On camping trips, people are grateful to have one around.

738.name: Vikavolt
738.description: A wild Vikavolt in the world.

739.name: Crabrawler
739.description: While guarding its weak points with its pincers, it looks for an opening and unleashes punches. When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.

740.name: Crabominable
740.description: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew thick fur.

741.name: Oricorio
741.description: It wins the hearts of its enemies with its passionate dancing and then uses the opening it creates to burn them up with blazing flames.

742.name: Cutiefly
742.description: Myriads of Cutiefly flutter above the heads of people who have auras resembling those of flowers. It can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

743.name: Ribombee
743.description: A wild Ribombee in the world.

744.name: Rockruff
744.description: A wild Rockruff in the world.

745.name: Lycanroc
745.description: It has a calm and collected demeanor. It swiftly closes in on its prey, then slices them with the rocks in its mane.

746.name: Wishiwashi
746.description: Individually, they're incredibly weak. It's by gathering up into schools that they're able to confront opponents.

747.name: Mareanie
747.description: It's found crawling on beaches and seafloors. The coral that grows on Corsola's head is as good as a five-star banquet to this Pokémon.

748.name: Toxapex
748.description: Those attacked by Toxapex's poison will suffer intense pain for three days and three nights. Post-recovery, there will be some aftereffects.

749.name: Mudbray
749.description: The mud stuck to Mudbray's hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait. Eating dirt, making mud, and playing in the mire form its daily routine.

750.name: Mudsdale
750.description: Its heavy, mud-covered kicks are its best means of attack, and it can reduce large trucks to scrap without breaking a sweat.

751.name: Dewpider
751.description: It crawls onto the land in search of food. When it comes across enemies or potential prey, this Pokémon smashes its water-bubble-covered head into them.

752.name: Araquanid
752.description: A wild Araquanid in the world.

753.name: Fomantis
753.description: During the day, it sleeps and soaks up light. They give off a sweet and refreshing scent. Cutiefly often gather near the tall grass where Fomantis are hiding.

754.name: Lurantis
754.description: A wild Lurantis in the world.

755.name: Morelull
755.description: As it drowses the day away, it nourishes itself by sucking from tree roots. It wakens at the fall of night, wandering off in search of a new tree.

756.name: Shiinotic
756.description: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.

757.name: Salandit
757.description: It burns its bodily fluids to create a sweet-smelling poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.

758.name: Salazzle
758.description: A wild Salazzle in the world.

759.name: Stufful
759.description: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling. It's an incredibly dangerous Pokémon.

760.name: Bewear
760.description: This Pokémon has the habit of hugging its companions. Many Trainers have left this world after their spines were squashed by its hug.

761.name: Bounsweet
761.description: A delectable aroma pours from its body. Bounsweet's sweat can be watered down into a juice with just the right amount of sweetness.

762.name: Steenee
762.description: The sepals on its head developed to protect its body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked by bird Pokémon, this Pokémon is totally fine.

763.name: Tsareena
763.description: Its long, striking legs aren't just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.

764.name: Comfey
764.description: It attaches flowers to its nutritious vine. Baths prepared with the flowers from its vine have a relaxing effect, so this Pokémon is a hit with many people.

765.name: Oranguru
765.description: Deep in the jungle, high in the lofty canopy, this Pokémon abides. On rare occasions, it shows up at the beach to match wits with Slowking.

766.name: Passimian
766.description: They battle with hard berries for weapons. They form groups of about 20 individuals. Their techniques are passed from the boss to the group, generation upon generation.

767.name: Wimpod
767.description: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake. It lives on beaches and seabeds.

768.name: Golisopod
768.description: It battles skillfully with its six arms, with a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater--or even air--right in two.

769.name: Sandygast
769.description: It takes control of anyone who puts a hand in its mouth, to add to the pile of its sand-mound body. This Pokémon embodies the grudges of the departed.

770.name: Palossand
770.description: Possessed people controlled by this Pokémon transformed its sand mound into a castle. As it evolved, its power to curse grew ever stronger.

771.name: Pyukumuku
771.description: It lives in shallow seas, such as areas near a beach. The sticky mucous that covers their bodies can be used to soothe sunburned skin. How convenient!

772.name: Type: Null
772.description: Due to the danger that this synthetic Pokémon may go on a rampage, it wears a control mask to restrain its capabilities. It has some hidden special power.

775.name: Komala
775.description: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.

776.name: Turtonator
776.description: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point. It gushes fire from its nostrils.

777.name: Togedemaru
777.description: A wild Togedemaru in the world.

778.name: Mimikyu
778.description: A wild Mimikyu in the world.

779.name: Bruxish
779.description: It stuns its prey with its psychic powers and then grinds them to mush with its strong teeth. Even Shellder's shell is no match for it.

780.name: Drampa
780.description: This Pokémon is friendly to people and loves children most of all. It comes from deep in the mountains to play with children it likes in town.

781.name: Dhelmise
781.description: The soul of seaweed adrift in the waves became reborn as this Pokémon. It maintains itself with new infusions of seabed detritus and seaweed.

782.name: Jangmo-o
782.description: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o live. They grow little by little battling one another.

783.name: Hakamo-o
783.description: It sheds and regrows its scales on a continuous basis. The scales become harder each time they're regrown. Its scaly punches tear its foes to shreds.

784.name: Kommo-o
784.description: A wild Kommo-o in the world.

785.name: Tapu Koko
785.description: It confuses its enemies by flying too quickly for the eye to follow. It has a hair-trigger temper but forgets what made it angry an instant later.

786.name: Tapu Lele
786.description: A fragrant aroma of flowers follows it. As it flutters about, it scatters its strangely glowing scales. Touching them is said to restore good health.

787.name: Tapu Bulu
787.description: It causes vegetation to grow, and then it absorbs energy from the growth. It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings them around at its enemies.

788.name: Tapu Fini
788.description: People say it can create pure water that will wash away any corruption. The dense fog it creates brings the downfall and destruction of its confused enemies.

789.name: Cosmog
789.description: In ages past, it was called the child of the stars. It's said to be a Pokémon from another world, but no specific details are known.

790.name: Cosmoem
790.description: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. There's something accumulating around the black core within its hard shell.

791.name: Solgaleo
791.description: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.

792.name: Lunala
792.description: When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world. This Pokémon devours light, drawing the moonless dark veil of night over the brightness of day.

793.name: Nihilego
793.description: One of several mysterious Ultra Beasts. It's unclear whether or not this Pokémon is sentient, but sometimes it can be observed behaving like a young girl.

794.name: Buzzwole
794.description: This life-form called an Ultra Beast appeared from another world. It shows off its body, but whether that display is a boast or a threat remains unclear.

795.name: Pheromosa
795.description: One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it refuses to touch anything, perhaps because it senses some uncleanness in this world.

796.name: Xurkitree
796.description: One of the mysterious life-forms known as Ultra Beasts. Astonishing electric shocks emanate from its entire body, according to witnesses.

797.name: Celesteela
797.description: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. One kind of Ultra Beast, witnesses saw it flying across the sky by expelling gas from its two arms.

798.name: Kartana
798.description: This Ultra Beast came from the Ultra Wormhole. It seems not to attack enemies on its own, but its sharp body is a dangerous weapon in itself.

799.name: Guzzlord
799.description: A dangerous Ultra Beast, it has gobbled mountains and swallowed whole buildings, according to reports. But for some reason its droppings have never been found.

800.name: Necrozma
800.description: Reminiscent of the Ultra Beasts, this life-form, apparently asleep underground, is thought to have come from another world in ancient times.

801.name: Magearna
801.description: This artificial Pokémon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak. Its true self is its Soul-Heart, an artificial soul.

802.name: Marshadow
802.description: Able to conceal itself in the shadows of others, it never appears before humans, so its very existence is the stuff of myth. This Pokémon is craven and cowering.

803.name: Poipole
803.description: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

804.name: Naganadel
804.description: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.

805.name: Stakataka
805.description: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life- forms stacked one on top of each other.

806.name: Blacephalon
806.description: It slithers toward people and explode its head without warning. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.

807.name: Zeraora
807.description: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.

808.name: Meltan
808.description: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

809.name: Melmetal
809.description: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

810.name: Grookey
810.description: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

811.name: Thwackey
811.description: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.

812.name: Rillaboom
812.description: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

813.name: Scorbunny
813.description: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

814.name: Raboot
814.description: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.

815.name: Cinderace
815.description: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.

816.name: Sobble
816.description: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

817.name: Drizzile
817.description: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.

818.name: Inteleon
818.description: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.

819.name: Skwovet
819.description: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

820.name: Greedent
820.description: It stashes berries in its tail--so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

821.name: Rookidee
821.description: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle--even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

822.name: Corvisquire
822.description: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

823.name: Corviknight
823.description: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

824.name: Blipbug
824.description: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn't.

825.name: Dottler
825.description: It barely moves, but it's still alive. Hiding in its shell without food or water seems to have awakened its psychic powers.

826.name: Orbeetle
826.description: It's famous for its high level of intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it also possesses immense psychic power.

827.name: Nickit
827.description: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

828.name: Thievul
828.description: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

829.name: Gossifleur
829.description: It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.

830.name: Eldegoss
830.description: The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of nutrients. It spreads them on the wind so that plants and other Pokémon can benefit from them.

831.name: Wooloo
831.description: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.

832.name: Dubwool
832.description: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You'll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.

833.name: Chewtle
833.description: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.

834.name: Drednaw
834.description: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.

835.name: Yamper
835.description: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.

836.name: Boltund
836.description: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

837.name: Rolycoly
837.description: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

838.name: Carkol
838.description: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.

839.name: Coalossal
839.description: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

840.name: Applin
840.description: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it's just an apple and nothing more.

841.name: Flapple
841.description: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.

842.name: Appletun
842.description: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.

843.name: Silicobra
843.description: As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in its neck pouch. The pouch can hold more than 17 pounds of sand.

844.name: Sandaconda
844.description: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.

845.name: Cramorant
845.description: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

846.name: Arrokuda
846.description: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.

847.name: Barraskewda
847.description: This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

848.name: Toxel
848.description: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

849.name: Toxtricity
849.description: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

850.name: Sizzlipede
850.description: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

851.name: Centiskorch
851.description: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

852.name: Clobbopus
852.description: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

853.name: Grapploct
853.description: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.

854.name: Sinistea
854.description: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

855.name: Polteageist
855.description: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

856.name: Hatenna
856.description: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

857.name: Hattrem
857.description: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

858.name: Hatterene
858.description: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

859.name: Impidimp
859.description: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

860.name: Morgrem
860.description: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it's trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

861.name: Grimmsnarl
861.description: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.

862.name: Obstagoon
862.description: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout--this move is known as Obstruct.

863.name: Perrserker
863.description: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

864.name: Cursola
864.description: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon's core spirit.

865.name: Sirfetch'd
865.description: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.

866.name: Mr. Rime
866.description: It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.

867.name: Runerigus
867.description: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.

868.name: Milcery
868.description: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

870.name: Falinks
870.description: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass's orders are absolute.

871.name: Pincurchin
871.description: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

872.name: Snom
872.description: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.

873.name: Frosmoth
873.description: Icy scales fall from its wings like snow as it flies over fields and mountains. The temperature of its wings is less than -290 degrees Fahrenheit.

874.name: Stonjourner
874.description: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

875.name: Eiscue
875.description: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.

876.name: Indeedee
876.description: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.

877.name: Morpeko
877.description: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

878.name: Cufant
878.description: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

879.name: Copperajah
879.description: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.

880.name: Dracozolt
880.description: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.

881.name: Arctozolt
881.description: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.

882.name: Dracovish
882.description: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.

883.name: Arctovish
883.description: Though it's able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.

884.name: Duraludon
884.description: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

885.name: Dreepy
885.description: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

886.name: Drakloak
886.description: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

887.name: Dragapult
887.description: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

888.name: Zacian
888.description: Known as a legendary hero, this Pokémon absorbs metal particles, transforming them into a weapon it uses to battle.

889.name: Zamazenta
889.description: In times past, it worked together with a king of the people to save the Galar region. It absorbs metal that it then uses in battle.

890.name: Eternatus
890.description: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.

891.name: Kubfu
891.description: Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves. The moves it masters will determine which form it takes when it evolves.

892.name: Urshifu
892.description: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.

893.name: Zarude
893.description: Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It's incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.

894.name: Regieleki
894.description: This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical energy. It's said that removing the rings on Regieleki's body will unleash the Pokémon's latent power.

895.name: Regidrago
895.description: An academic theory proposes that Regidrago's arms were once the head of an ancient dragon Pokémon. The theory remains unproven.

896.name: Glastrier
896.description: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It's also a belligerent Pokémon-- anything it wants, it takes by force.

897.name: Spectrier
897.description: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one--it doesn't use its sense of sight. Spectrier's kicks are said to separate soul from body.

898.name: Calyrex
898.description: Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.

899.name: Wyrdeer
899.description: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when it is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat and is useful for winter clothing.

900.name: Kleavor
900.description: A violent creature that fells trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. Should one encounter this Pokémon in the wild, one's only recourse is to flee.

901.name: Ursaluna
901.description: Swampy terrain gives Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

902.name: Basculegion
902.description: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species in all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

903.name: Sneasler
