903.description: Because of its wicked poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on frozen highlands. It prefers solitude and doesn't form packs.

904.name: Overqwil
904.description: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname “Sea Fiend”. It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

905.name: Enamorus
905.description: Its arrival brings an end to the winter. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across the land.

906.name: Venusaur
906.description: In order to support its flower, which has grown larger due to Mega Evolution, its back and legs have become stronger.

907.name: Charizard
907.description: The overwhelming power that fills its entire body causes it to turn black and creates intense blue flames.

908.name: Charizard
908.description: Its bond with its Trainer is the source of its power. It boasts speed and maneuverability greater than that of a jet fighter.

909.name: Blastoise
909.description: The cannon on its back is as powerful as a tank gun. Its tough legs and back enable it to withstand the recoil from firing the cannon.

910.name: Beedrill
910.description: Its legs have become poison stingers. It stabs its prey repeatedly with the stingers on its limbs, dealing the final blow with the stinger on its rear.

911.name: Pidgeot
911.description: With its muscular strength now greatly increased, it can fly continuously for two weeks without resting.

912.name: Alakazam
912.description: Having traded away its muscles, Alakazam's true power has been unleashed. With its psychic powers, it can foresee all things.

913.name: Slowbro
913.description: When bathed in the energy of Mega Evolution, Shellder converts into impregnable armor. There is virtually no change in Slowpoke.

914.name: Gengar
914.description: Gengar's relationships are warped. It tries to take the lives of anyone and everyone. It will even try to curse the Trainer who is its master!

915.name: Kangaskhan
915.description: When the mother sees the back of her Mega-Evolved child, it makes her think of the day when her child will inevitably leave her.

916.name: Pinsir
916.description: The influence of Mega Evolution leaves it in a state of constant excitement. It pierces enemies with its two large horns before shredding them.

917.name: Gyarados
917.description: Although it obeys its instinctive drive to destroy everything within its reach, it will respond to orders from a Trainer it truly trusts.

918.name: Aerodactyl
918.description: The power of Mega Evolution has completely restored its genes. The rocks on its body are harder than diamond.

919.name: Mewtwo
919.description: Psychic power has augmented its muscles. It has a grip strength of one ton and can sprint a hundred meters in two seconds flat!

920.name: Mewtwo
920.description: Despite its diminished size, its mental power has grown phenomenally. With a mere thought, it can smash a skyscraper to smithereens.

921.name: Ampharos
921.description: Massive amounts of energy intensely stimulated Ampharos's cells, apparently awakening its long-sleeping dragon's blood.

922.name: Steelix
922.description: The cells within its body, crystallized by the energy produced from Mega Evolution, are stronger than any mineral and able to withstand any temperature.

923.name: Scizor
923.description: The excess energy that bathes this Pokémon keeps it in constant danger of overflow. It can't sustain a battle over long periods of time.

924.name: Heracross
924.description: A tremendous influx of energy builds it up, but when Mega Evolution ends, Heracross is bothered by terrible soreness in its muscles.

925.name: Houndoom
925.description: Its red claws and the tips of its tail are melting from high internal temperatures that are painful to Houndoom itself.

926.name: Tyranitar
926.description: Due to the colossal power poured into it, this Pokémon's back split right open. Its destructive instincts are the only thing keeping it moving.

927.name: Sceptile
927.description: Thanks to the power in its quick legs, Mega Sceptile can be on its opponent in a flash. It can cut off a portion of its tail to fire it like a missile at an opponent.

928.name: Blaziken
928.description: As it unleashes a flurry of savage kicks, its legs can begin to burn from the friction of the surrounding atmosphere. They're always a source of pride to it.

929.name: Swampert
929.description: When it Mega Evolves, the strength that it needs to act in the water is increased. It can use its tenacious power both on land and in the water.

930.name: Gardevoir
930.description: By opening its heart, Mega Gardevoir becomes able to use tremendous psychic power. The red plate in its chest is said to be a physical manifestation of its heart.

931.name: Sableye
931.description: Bathed in the energy of Mega Evolution, the gemstone on its chest expands, rips through its skin, and falls out.

932.name: Mawile
932.description: Its two sets of jaws thrash about violently as if they each had a will of their own. One gnash from them can turn a boulder to dust.

933.name: Aggron
933.description: When Aggron Mega Evolves into Mega Aggron, the destructive ability of its fearsome horns can turn a steel-clad tank into so much scrap metal.

934.name: Medicham
934.description: It uses its amped-up willpower to create additional arms for itself. The more it has trained its spirit, the more realistic and dexterous these arms become.

935.name: Manectric
935.description: Too much electricity has built up in its body, irritating Manectric. Its explosive speed is equal to that of a lightning bolt.

936.name: Sharpedo
936.description: The yellow patterns it bears are old scars. The energy from Mega Evolution runs through them, causing it sharp pain and suffering.

937.name: Camerupt
937.description: The humps on its back have transformed into one large and very active volcano. It has a deep hatred of water or any moisture and has an explosive personality.

938.name: Altaria
938.description: It sings with a voice that is even more beautiful than before it Mega Evolved. Its feathers became larger for protection and glimmer with an iridescent sheen.

939.name: Banette
939.description: Extraordinary energy amplifies its cursing power to such an extent that it can't help but curse its own Trainer.

940.name: Absol
940.description: As the energy of Mega Evolution fills it, its fur bristles. What you see on its back are not true wings, and this Pokémon isn't able to fly.

941.name: Glalie
941.description: The power of Mega Evolution was so strong that it smashed Glalie's jaw. Its inability to eat very well leaves Glalie irritated.

942.name: Salamence
942.description: Mega Evolution fuels its brutality, and it may even turn on the Trainer who raised it. It's been dubbed the blood-soaked. crescent.

943.name: Metagross
943.description: When it knows it can't win, it digs the claws on its legs into its opponent and starts the countdown to a big explosion.

944.name: Latias
944.description: Its body is smaller than Mega Latios's body. It is more agile and can make very sharp turns. When it Mega Evolves, its defensive strength grows substantially.

945.name: Latios
945.description: It's larger than Mega Latias, and can achieve higher speeds in flight. This Pokémon can use its speed in battle to unleash a flurry of attacks.

946.name: Lopunny
946.description: Mega Evolution awakens its combative instincts. It has shed any fur that got in the way of its attacks. crescent.

947.name: Garchomp
947.description: Excess energy melted its arms and wings into giant scythes, sending it mad with rage. It swings its scythes wildly and slices the ground to pieces.

948.name: Lucario
948.description: It readies itself to face its enemies by focusing its mental energies. Its fighting style can be summed up in a single word: heartless.

949.name: Abomasnow
949.description: The sprouts on Abomasnow's back grow into great shafts of ice when it Mega Evolves. Dislikes associating with others and chooses to live quietly deep in mountains.

950.name: Gallade
950.description: Mega Gallade has a knightly appearance. It can use its psychic power to reshape both arms into blades simultaneously and fight using a dual-wielding style.

951.name: Audino
951.description: Mega Audino emits a soothing pulse from its body that reduces hostility in others. Anything that comes into contact with its second feelers will fall into a deep sleep.

952.name: Diancie
952.description: The impurities upon its body's surface have fallen away, sparkling so brilliantly that cannot be observed directly. It is known as “the Royal Pink Princess”.

953.name: Rayquaza
953.description: Particles stream from the filaments that extend from its jaw. They can control the density and humidity of the air, allowing Rayquaza to manipulate the weather.

954.name: Kyogre
954.description: When Kyogre roared, water poured forth and the seas spread outward. Dark clouds enshrouded the world, and the deluge fell upon all…

955.name: Groudon
955.description: When Groudon howled, the earth swelled and the land grew wide. The sun blazed atop and all the world around the creature was enveloped in incandescent heat.

956.name: Rattata
956.description: With its incisors, it gnaws through doors and infiltrates people's homes. Then, with a twitch of its whiskers, it steals whatever food it finds.

957.name: Raticate
957.description: A wild Raticate in the world.

958.name: Raichu
958.description: It uses psychokinesis to control electricity. It focuses psychic energy into its tail and rides it like it's surfing. Another name for this Pokémon is 'hodad'.

959.name: Sandshrew
959.description: Life on mountains covered with deep snow has granted this Pokémon a body of ice that's as hard as steel. Predators go after its soft belly.

960.name: Sandslash
960.description: It uses large, hooked claws to cut a path through deep snow as it runs. On snowy mountains, this Sandslash is faster than any other Pokémon.

961.name: Vulpix
961.description: They live together in a skulk, helping one another. In hot weather, this Pokémon makes ice shards with its six tails and sprays them around to cool itself off.

962.name: Ninetales
962.description: While it will guide travelers who get lost on a snowy mountain down to the mountain's base, it won't forgive anyone who harms nature.

963.name: Diglett
963.description: The metal-rich geology of its habitat caused it to develop steel whiskers on its head that change shape depending on its mood and when communicating with others.

964.name: Dugtrio
964.description: Their beautiful, metallic whiskers create a sort of protective helmet on heir heads, and they also function as highly precise sensors.

965.name: Meowth
965.description: It's accustomed to luxury because it used to live with Alolan royalty. Highly smart and proud, it's famously difficult to handle, but that also makes it popular.

966.name: Persian
966.description: It looks down on everyone other than itself. In contrast to its lovely face, it is so brutal that it tortures its weakened prey rather than finishing them off.

967.name: Geodude
967.description: Its body is a magnetic stone. Iron sand attach to parts of its body with stronger magnetism. If you carelessly step on one, it will headbutt and shock you in anger.

968.name: Graveler
968.description: When two Graveler smash each other over dravite, their favorite food, they cause flashes of light and booming noises. People call them “fireworks of the earth.”

969.name: Golem
969.description: It fires rocks charged with electricity. Even if the rock isn't fired that accurately, just grazing an opponent will cause numbness and fainting.

970.name: Grimer
970.description: There are a hundred or so of them living in Alola's waste-disposal site. They're all hard workers who eat a lot of trash. Grimer seems to relish any and all kinds of trash.

971.name: Muk
971.description: While it's unexpectedly quiet and friendly, if it's not fed any trash for a while,, it will smash its Trainer's furnishings, and eat up the fragments.

972.name: Exeggutor
972.description: Alola is the best environment for this Pokémon. Local people take pride in its appearance, saying this is how Exeggutor ought to look.

973.name: Marowak
973.description: A wild Marowak in the world.

974.name: Meowth
974.description: Living with a savage, seafaring people has hardened its body so much that parts of it turned to iron. Darker coins are harder and garner more respect among Meowth.

975.name: Ponyta
975.description: Its small horn hides a healing power. This Pokémon will look into your eyes and read the contents of your heart. If it finds evil there, it promptly hides away.

976.name: Rapidash
976.description: Little can stand up to its psycho cut. Unleashed from this Pokémon's horn, the move will punch a hole right through a thick metal sheet.

977.name: Slowpoke
977.description: Although it is normally zoned out, its expression abruptly sharpens on occasion. The cause seems to lie in Slowpoke's diet, which also give their tails a spicy flavor.

978.name: Slowbro
978.description: A Shellder bite set off a chemical reaction with the spices inside Slowbro's body, causing Slowbro to become a Poison-type Pokémon.

979.name: Farfetch'd
979.description: The stalks of leeks are thicker and longer in the Galar region. Brave Farfetch'd warriors that adapted to these stalks took on a unique form.

980.name: Weezing
980.description: Long ago, when droves of factories fouled the air with pollution, it changed into this form for some reason. It consumes air pollutant particles, expelling clean air.

981.name: Mr. Mime
981.description: Its talent is tap-dancing. It can radiate chilliness from the bottoms of its feet to to create a floor of ice, which this Pokémon can kick up to use as a barrier.

982.name: Articuno
982.description: It fires beams that immobilize opponents as if they had been frozen solid. Its feather-like blades of psychic energy rip through thick iron sheets like paper.

983.name: Zapdos
983.description: When its feathers rub together, they produce a crackling sound like the zapping of electricity. Apparently, it runs through the mountains at over 180 mph.

984.name: Moltres
984.description: This Pokémon's sinister, flame-like aura will consume the spirit of any creature it hits. Victims become burned-out shadows of themselves.

985.name: Slowking
985.description: A combination of toxins and the shock of evolving has increased Shellder's intelligence to the point that Shellder now controls Slowking.

986.name: Corsola
986.description: Sudden climate change wiped out this ancient kind of Corsola. With its branches, it absorbs others' life-force. It curses those unaware that kick it by accident.

987.name: Zigzagoon
987.description: Its restlessness has it constantly moving in zigzags. It will purposely run into other Pokémon to start fights. It's thought to be the oldest form of Zigzagoon.

988.name: Linoone
988.description: This very aggressive Pokémon will recklessly challenge opponents stronger than itself. It uses its long tongue to taunt them to then tackle forcefully.

989.name: Darumaka
989.description: The colder they get, the more energetic they are. They freeze their breath to make snowballs, using them as ammo for playful snowball fights.

990.name: Darmanitan
990.description: On days when blizzards blow through, it comes down to where people live. It stashes food in the snowball on its head, taking it home for later.

991.name: Yamask
991.description: A clay slab with cursed engravings took possession of a Yamask. The slab is said to be absorbing the Yamask's dark power.

992.name: Stunfisk
992.description: Its conspicuous lips lure prey in as it lies in wait in the mud. When prey gets close, Stunfisk clamps its jagged steel fins down on them.

993.name: Growlithe
993.description: They patrol their territory in pairs. It's believed the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

994.name: Arcanine
994.description: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase.

995.name: Voltorb
995.description: It resembles an ancient Poké Ball design. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.

996.name: Electrode
996.description: The tissue on the surface of its body is similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, it lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.

997.name: Typhlosion
997.description: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. It's believed its form was influenced by the energy of Mt. Coronet in ancient times.

998.name: Qwilfish
998.description: A form of Qwilfish from the distant past. Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere.

999.name: Sneasel
999.description: Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught.

1000.name: Samurott
1000.description: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui.

1001.name: Lilligant
1001.description: Its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

1002.name: Zorua
1002.description: Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

1003.name: Zoroark
1003.description: Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.

1004.name: Braviary
1004.description: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt.

1005.name: Sliggoo
1005.description: A creature given to melancholy. Its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.

1006.name: Goodra
1006.description: It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy--it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

1007.name: Avalugg
1007.description: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease.

1008.name: Decidueye
1008.description: The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui's extreme cold.

1009.name: Pikachu
1009.description: A wild Pikachu in the world.

1010.name: Pikachu
1010.description: A wild Pikachu in the world.

1011.name: Pikachu
1011.description: A wild Pikachu in the world.

1012.name: Pikachu
1012.description: A wild Pikachu in the world.

1013.name: Pikachu
1013.description: A wild Pikachu in the world.

1014.name: Pikachu
1014.description: A wild Pikachu in the world.

1015.name: Pikachu
1015.description: This Pikachu wears its partner's cap, which is proof of the strong bond Pikachu and its partner formed during adventures across many different regions.

1016.name: Pikachu
1016.description: This Pikachu wears its partner's cap, which is proof of the strong bond Pikachu and its partner formed during adventures across the Hoenn region together.

1017.name: Pikachu
1017.description: This Pikachu wears its partner's cap, which is proof of the strong bond Pikachu and its partner formed during adventures across the Sinnoh region together.

1018.name: Pikachu
1018.description: This Pikachu wears its partner's cap, which is proof of the strong bond Pikachu and its partner formed during adventures across the Unova region together.

1019.name: Pikachu
1019.description: This Pikachu wears its partner's cap, which is proof of the strong bond Pikachu and its partner formed during adventures across the Kalos region together.

1020.name: Pikachu
1020.description: This Pikachu wears its partner's cap, which is proof of the strong bond Pikachu and its partner formed during adventures across the Alola region together.

1021.name: Pikachu
1021.description: This Pikachu wears its partner's cap, which is proof of the strong bond Pikachu and its partner formed as the two overcame many hardships together.

1022.name: Pikachu
1022.description: This Pikachu wears its partner's cap, which is proof of the strong bond Pikachu and its partner formed during adventures across the world together.

1023.name: Pichu
1023.description: A wild Pichu in the world.

1051.name: Castform
1051.description: Castform takes this form on bright days. In an experiment where is was placed in front of a heater, it didn't change to this form. Its body is warm and toasty.

1052.name: Castform
1052.description: This is Castform's form while it's raining. In an experiment where it was placed in a shower, it didn't change to this form. Its body is soft, slightly swollen with water.

1053.name: Castform
1053.description: This is Castform's form in a hailstorm. In an experiment where it was placed in a freezer, it didn't change to this form. Its cold skin is as smooth as ice.

1054.name: Deoxys
1054.description: This Deoxys has transformed into its aggressive guise. It can fool enemies by altering its appearance.

1055.name: Deoxys
1055.description: When it changes form, an aurora appears. It absorbs attacks by altering its cellular structure.

1056.name: Deoxys
1056.description: A Pokémon that mutated from an extraterrestrial virus exposed to a laser beam. Its body is configured for superior agility and speed.

1057.name: Burmy
1057.description: It weaves a cloak together with sand, mud, and silk it spits out. This earthen cloak is ruined by wind and rain, so the Pokémon hides away in caves and other such places.

1058.name: Burmy
1058.description: When confronted by a lack of other materials, Burmy will create its cloak using dust and refuse. The cloak seems to be more comfortable than one would think.

1059.name: Wormadam
1059.description: Its earthen skin is reasonably hard, it has no problem repelling a Starly's pecking. It is said that a Wormadam that evolves on a cold day will have a thicker cloak.

1060.name: Wormadam
1060.description: Its body, composed of refuse, blends in to the scenery enough to be inconspicuous. This seems to be the perfect way for it to evade the detection of predators.

1061.name: Cherrim
1061.description: Cherrim takes this form on sunny days. Its faint scent entices bug Pokémon to it. It immediately closes its petals and becomes immobile once the sun hides.

1062.name: Shellos
1062.description: It's capable of spending a limited amount of time on land until their skin dries out. One theory suggests that living in cold seas causes Shellos to take on this form.

1063.name: Gastrodon
1063.description: Found more often on land than in the sea. They normally live in rocky seashores, but when cloudy or rainy, they can sometimes be found on mountains, far from the sea.

1064.name: Rotom
1064.description: If the convection microwave oven is not working properly, then the Rotom inhabiting it will become lethargic. It makes mischief by turning up the heat.

1065.name: Rotom
1065.description: It enjoys coming up with water-based pranks. The model of washing machine that Rotom can inspirit has been discontinued, so they are now traded at high prices.

1066.name: Rotom
1066.description: In this form, Rotom likes to play freezing cold pranks. You may find it's turned the bath you just filled to solid ice! It battles by spewing cold air.

1067.name: Rotom
1067.description: The first appliance developed that Rotom coud inspirit was the electric fan. It uses its power over wind in its pranks, happily blowing any important documents it finds.

1068.name: Rotom
1068.description: The lawn mower is an appliance that led to the development of the Rotom Dex. It will mow down grass and flowers, then swagger around with pride at its accomplishments.

1069.name: Dialga
1069.description: Radiant light caused Dialga to take on a form bearing a striking resemblance to the creator Pokémon. It wields such a colossal strength that this might be its true form.

1070.name: Palkia
1070.description: It soars across the sky in a form that resembles the creator of all things. Perhaps this imitation of appearance is a strategy for gaining Arceus's powers.

1071.name: Giratina
1071.description: Giratina loses its legs upon changing into this form. It's believed it hails from a world where the heavens and the earth are as one.

1072.name: Shaymin
1072.description: Upon taking in the scent of a particular rare flower, Shaymin is enveloped in light and its tiny body transforms, confering the power of flight upon it.

1090.name: Basculin
1090.description: They form schools with others of the same color. The greatest foe of a school of blue Basculin is a school of red Basculin. Its flavor is light and inoffensive.

1091.name: Basculin
1091.description: While this ancient form of Basculin shares a vast array of qualities with other forms, it differs in several respects, including demeanor, being much gentler than others.

1092.name: Darmanitan
1092.description: When wounded, it stops moving. It goes as still as stone to meditate, sharpening its mind and spirit.

1093.name: Darmanitan
1093.description: Darmanitan takes this form when enraged. It won't stop spewing flames until its rage has settled, even if its body starts to melt.

1094.name: Deerling
1094.description: To prevent Deerling from entering their fields, many farmers will have several Lycanroc stand guard, as they are its natural enemy.

1095.name: Deerling
1095.description: Deerling have different scents depending on the season. In this form, Deerling have a softly sweet scent that lingers in the nose.

1096.name: Deerling
1096.description: Deerling's scent changes with the seasons, but when the Pokémon is in its Winter Form, it has hardly any scent at all.

1097.name: Sawsbuck
1097.description: The thicker and larger the branches and leaves on its antlers, the more majestic the Sawsbuck is thought to be.

1098.name: Sawsbuck
1098.description: Sawsbuck in their Autumn Form are known for having very short tempers. The males fight each other incessantly.

1099.name: Sawsbuck
1099.description: Though there are many enthusiasts for Sawsbuck as a species, this seasonal form in particular is not very popular.

1100.name: Tornadus
1100.description: An example of what is known as a “form change”. Tornadus has been sighted crossing the ocean while in this form.

1101.name: Thundurus
1101.description: It pulverizes foes into nothingness with showers of devastatingly powerful lightning bolts launched from the string of orbs on its tail.

1102.name: Landorus
1102.description: Landorus soars through the sky in this form, bestowing plentiful harvests upon the land and earning the people's reverence.

1103.name: Enamorus
1103.description: From the clouds, it descends upon those who treat any form of life with disrespect and metes out wrathful, ruthless punishment.

1104.name: Kyurem
1104.description: The sameness of Reshiram's and Kyurem's genes allowed Kyurem to absorb Reshiram. Kyurem can now use the power of both fire and ice.

1105.name: Kyurem
1105.description: The sameness of Zekrom's and Kyurem's genes allowed Kyurem to absorb Zekrom. Kyurem can now use the power of both electricity and ice.

1106.name: Keldeo
1106.description: The power that lay hidden in its body now covers its horn, turning it into a sword that can slice through anything.

1107.name: Meloetta
1107.description: Meloetta's melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

1112.name: Greninja
1112.description: A wild Greninja in the world.

1113.name: Greninja
1113.description: A wild Greninja in the world.

1114.description: A wild Vivillon Polar in the world.

1116.description: A wild Vivillon Continental in the world.

1118.description: A wild Vivillon Elegant in the world.

1122.description: A wild Vivillon Archipelago in the world.

1124.description: A wild Vivillon Sandstorm in the world.

1125.name: Vivillon River

1127.description: A wild Vivillon Savanna in the world.

1128.name: Vivillon Sun

1129.description: A wild Vivillon Ocean in the world.

1130.description: A wild Vivillon Jungle in the world.

1131.name: Vivillon Fancy
1131.description: A wild Vivillon Fancy in the world.

1132.name: Vivillon Pokeball
1132.description: A wild Vivillon Pokeball in the world.

1133.name: Flabebe Yellow
1133.description: A wild Flabebe Yellow in the world.

1134.name: Flabebe Orange
1134.description: A wild Flabebe Orange in the world.

1135.name: Flabebe Blue
1135.description: A wild Flabebe Blue in the world.

1136.name: Flabebe White
1136.description: A wild Flabebe White in the world.

1138.name: Floette Orange
1138.description: A wild Floette Orange in the world.

1139.name: Floette Blue
1139.description: A wild Floette Blue in the world.

1140.name: Floette White
1140.description: A wild Floette White in the world.

1141.name: Floette Eternal
1141.description: The flower it's holding can no longer be found blooming anywhere. It's also thought to contain terrifying power.

1142.name: Florges Yellow
1142.description: A wild Florges Yellow in the world.

1143.name: Florges Orange
1143.description: A wild Florges Orange in the world.

1144.name: Florges Blue
1144.description: A wild Florges Blue in the world.

1145.name: Florges White
1145.description: A wild Florges White in the world.

1155.name: Meowstic
1155.description: Females are a bit more selfish and aggressive than males. If they don't get what they want, they will torment you with their psychic abilities.

1156.name: Aegislash
1156.description: Once upon a time, a king with an Aegislash reigned over the land. His Pokémon eventually drained him of life, and his kingdom fell with him.

1157.name: Pumpkaboo
1157.description: When taking spirits to the afterlife, small Pumpkaboo prefer the spirits of children to those of adults.

1158.name: Pumpkaboo
1158.description: When taking spirits to the afterlife, large Pumpkaboo prefer the spirits of adults to those of children.

1159.name: Pumpkaboo
1159.description: Supersized Pumpkaboo are very partial to the spirits of people who were of similarly superior proportions.

1160.name: Gourgeist
1160.description: A small-sized Pumpkaboo evolves into a small-sized Gourgeist. Its bodily proportions also get passed on to its descendants.

1161.name: Gourgeist
1161.description: A large-sized Pumpkaboo evolves into a large-sized Gourgeist. Its bodily proportions also get passed on to its descendants.

1162.name: Gourgeist
1162.description: A supersized Pumpkaboo evolves into a supersized Gourgeist. Its bodily proportions also get passed on to its descendants.

1163.name: Xerneas
1163.description: A wild Xerneas in the world.

1164.name: Zygarde
1164.description: A wild Zygarde in the world.

1165.name: Zygarde
1165.description: A wild Zygarde in the world.

1166.name: Zygarde
1166.description: A wild Zygarde in the world.

1167.name: Zygarde
1167.description: This is Zygarde's perfected form. From the orifice on its chest, it radiates high-powered energy that eliminates everything.

1168.name: Hoopa
1168.description: It is the true form of Hoopa, which has had its power sealed away. The rings it carries have the power to bend dimensions and are able to seize anything in the world.

1169.name: Oricorio
1169.description: This form of Oricorio has sipped yellow nectar. It uses nimble steps to approach opponents, then knocks them out with electric punches.

1170.name: Oricorio
1170.description: This form of Oricorio has sipped pink nectar. It elevates its mind with the gentle steps of its dance, then unleashes its psychic energy.

1171.name: Oricorio
1171.description: It charms its opponents with its refined dancing. When they let their guard down, it places a curse on them that will bring on their demise.

1172.name: Rockruff
1172.description: A wild Rockruff in the world.

1173.name: Lycanroc
1173.description: This Pokémon uses its rocky mane to slash any who approach. It will even disobey its Trainer if it dislikes the orders it was given.

1174.name: Lycanroc
1174.description: These Pokémon have both calm and ferocious qualities. It's said that this form of Lycanroc is the most troublesome to raise.

1175.name: Wishiwashi
1175.description: When facing tough opponents, they get into formation. But if they get wounded in battle, they'll scatter and become solitary again.

1206.name: Mimikyu
1206.description: A wild Mimikyu in the world.

1207.name: Necrozma
1207.description: This is its form while it is devouring the light of Solgaleo. It pounces on foes and then slashes them with the claws on its four limbs and back.

1208.name: Necrozma
1208.description: This is its form while it's devouring the light of Lunala. It grasps foes in its giant claws and rips them apart with brute force.

1209.name: Necrozma
1209.description: The light pouring out from all over its body affects living things and nature, impacting them in various ways.

1210.name: Magearna
1210.description: This is its form from almost 500 years ago. Its body is nothing more than a container-its artificial heart is the actual life-form.

1211.name: Cramorant
1211.description: Cramorant's gluttony led it to try to swallow an Arrokuda whole, which in turn led to Cramorant getting an Arrokuda stuck in its throat.

1212.name: Cramorant
1212.description: This Cramorant has accidentally gotten a Pikachu lodged in its gullet. Cramorant is choking a little, but it isn't really bothered.

1213.name: Toxtricity
1213.description: Capable of generating 15,000 volts of electricity, this Pokémon looks down on all that would challenge it.

1214.name: Sinistea
1214.description: The swirl pattern in this Pokémon's body is its weakness. If it gets stirred, the swirl loses its shape, and Sinistea gets dizzy.

1215.name: Polteageist
1215.description: Trainers Polteageist trusts will be allowed to experience its distinctive flavor and aroma firsthand by sampling just a tiny bit of its tea.

1224.name: Eiscue
1224.description: The hair on its head connects to the surface of its brain. When this Pokémon has something on its mind, its hair chills the air around it.

1225.name: Indeedee
1225.description: They diligently serve people and Pokémon so they can gather feelings of gratitude. The females are particularly good at babysitting.

1226.name: Morpeko
1226.description: Intense hunger drives it to extremes of violence, and the electricity in its cheek sacs has converted into a Dark-type energy.

1227.name: Zacian
1227.description: Able to cut down anything with a single strike, it became known as the Fairy King's Sword, and it inspired awe in friend and foe alike.

1228.name: Zamazenta
1228.description: Its ability to deflect any attack led to it being known as the Fighting Master's Shield. It was feared and respected by all.

1229.name: Eternatus
1229.description: As a result of Rose's meddling, Eternatus absorbed all the energy in the Galar region. It's now in a state of power overload.

1230.name: Urshifu
1230.description: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in defeating foes by raining many blows down on them. Its strikes are nonstop, flowing like a river.

1231.name: Zarude
1231.description: This Zarude's special strength stems from its love and care for an orphaned human child that the Pokémon has raised.

1232.name: Calyrex
1232.description: According to lore, this Pokémon showed no mercy to those who got in its way, yet it would heal its opponents' wounds after battle.

1233.name: Calyrex
1233.description: It's said that Calyrex and a Pokémon that had bonded with it ran all across the Galar region to bring green to the wastelands.

1234.name: Basculegion
1234.description: The souls of its comrades cloak its body and propel it effortlessly through even raging rapids.

1289.name: Sprigatito
1289.description: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.

1290.name: Floragato
1290.description: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.

1291.name: Meowscarada
1291.description: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.

1292.name: Fuecoco
1292.description: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco's head and flickers to and fro.

1293.name: Crocalor
1293.description: The combination of Crocalor's fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon's head.

1294.name: Skeledirge
1294.description: Skeledirge's gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.

1295.name: Quaxly
1295.description: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.

1296.name: Quaxwell
1296.description: The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokémon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.

1297.name: Quaquaval
1297.description: A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.

1298.name: Lechonk
1298.description: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn't use it for anything other than foraging.

1299.name: Oinkologne
1299.description: Oinkologne is proud of its fine, glossy skin. It emits a concentrated scent from the tip of its tail.

1300.name: Oinkologne
1300.description: This is a meticulous Pokémon that likes to keep things tidy. It shrouds itself in a floral aroma that soothes the Pokémon around it.

1301.name: Tarountula
1301.description: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread's strength is the topic of ongoing research.

1302.name: Spidops
1302.description: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.

1303.name: Nymble
1303.description: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

1304.name: Lokix
1304.description: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.

1305.name: Pawmi
1305.description: The pads of its paws are electricity- discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

1306.name: Pawmo
1306.description: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

1307.name: Pawmot
1307.description: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

1308.name: Tandemaus
1308.description: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

1309.name: Maushold
1309.description: The little one just appeared one day. They all live together like a family, but the relationship between the three is still unclear.

1310.name: Maushold
1310.description: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

1311.name: Fidough
1311.description: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough's breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon's vicinity.

1312.name: Dachsbun
1312.description: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon's body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.

1313.name: Smoliv
1313.description: This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a whole week without eating or drinking.

1314.name: Dolliv
1314.description: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh- scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

1315.name: Arboliva
1315.description: This Pokémon drives back enemies by launching its rich, aromatic oil at them with enough force to smash a boulder.

1316.name: Squawkabilly
1316.description: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they're out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

1317.name: Squawkabilly
1317.description: The largest of their flocks can contain more than 50 individuals. They fly around towns and forests, searching for food and making a racket.

1318.name: Squawkabilly
1318.description: These Squawkabilly are hotheaded, and their fighting style is vicious. They'll leap within reach of their foes to engage in close combat.

1319.name: Squawkabilly
1319.description: Though these Squawkabilly are the fewest in number, they have no trouble living in towns since they blend in with the white buildings.

1320.name: Nacli
1320.description: The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave salt behind. Salt is constantly being created and replenished inside Nacli's body.

1321.name: Naclstack
1321.description: It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.

1322.name: Garganacl
1322.description: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.

1323.name: Charcadet
1323.description: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

1324.name: Armarouge
1324.description: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

1325.name: Ceruledge
1325.description: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

1326.name: Tadbulb
1326.description: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

1327.name: Bellibolt
1327.description: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly- button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

1328.name: Wattrel
1328.description: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

1329.name: Kilowattrel
1329.description: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There's hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.

1330.name: Maschiff
1330.description: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.

1331.name: Mabosstiff
1331.description: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

1332.name: Shroodle
1332.description: To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.

1333.name: Grafaiai
1333.description: Each Grafaiai paints its own individual pattern, and it will paint that same pattern over and over again throughout its life.

1334.name: Bramblin
1334.description: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

1335.name: Brambleghast
1335.description: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.

1336.name: Toedscool
1336.description: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

1337.name: Toedscruel
1337.description: These Pokémon gather into groups and form colonies deep within forests. They absolutely hate it when strangers approach.

1338.name: Klawf
1338.description: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can't remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.

1339.name: Capsakid
1339.description: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

1340.name: Scovillain
1340.description: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

1341.name: Rellor
1341.description: This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud ball more than its own life.

1342.name: Rabsca
1342.description: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.

1343.name: Flittle
1343.description: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

1344.name: Espathra
1344.description: It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in psychic power from its large eyes. Despite its appearance, it has a vicious temperament.

1345.name: Tinkatink
1345.description: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it's satisfied with the result.

1346.name: Tinkatuff
1346.description: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other's hammers by smashing them together.

1347.name: Tinkaton
1347.description: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.

1348.name: Wiglett
1348.description: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

1349.name: Wugtrio
1349.description: A variety of fish Pokémon, Wugtrio was once considered to be a regional form of Dugtrio.

1350.name: Bombirdier
1350.description: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

1351.name: Finizen
1351.description: Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.

1352.name: Palafin
1352.description: This Pokémon changes its appearance if it hears its allies calling for help. Palafin will never show anybody its moment of transformation.

1353.name: Palafin
1353.description: This Pokémon's ancient genes have awakened. It is now so extraordinarily strong that it can easily lift a cruise ship with one fin.

1354.name: Varoom
1354.description: The steel section is Varoom's actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.

1355.name: Revavroom
1355.description: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders- now numbering eight-to generate energy.

1356.name: Cyclizar
1356.description: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider's body heat warms Cyclizar's back and lifts the Pokémon's spirit.

1357.name: Orthworm
1357.description: When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the opponent with a storm of punches.

1358.name: Glimmet
1358.description: Glimmet's toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals. This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like pollen to protect itself.

1359.name: Glimmora
1359.description: Glimmora's petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.

1360.name: Greavard
1360.description: This friendly Pokémon doesn't like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

1361.name: Houndstone
1361.description: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.

1362.name: Flamigo
1362.description: Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as “synchronizing,” an entire flock of these Pokémon can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony.

1363.name: Cetoddle
1363.description: This species left the ocean and began living on land a very long time ago. It seems to be closely related to Wailmer.

1364.name: Cetitan
1364.description: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.

1365.name: Veluza
1365.description: Veluza has excellent regenerative capabilities. It sheds spare flesh from its body to boost its agility, then charges at its prey.

1366.name: Dondozo
1366.description: It treats Tatsugiri like its boss and follows it loyally. Though powerful, Dondozo is apparently not very smart.

1367.name: Tatsugiri
1367.description: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

1368.name: Tatsugiri
1368.description: This Pokémon tricks its opponents by playing dead. It is small and weak, but it uses its smarts to survive.

1369.name: Tatsugiri
1369.description: It's one of the most intelligent dragon Pokémon. It camouflages itself by inflating its throat sac.

1370.name: Annihilape
1370.description: When its anger rose beyond a critical point, this Pokémon gained power that is unfettered by the limits of its physical body.

1371.name: Clodsire
1371.description: When attacked, this Pokémon will retaliate by sticking thick spines out from its body. It's a risky move that puts everything on the line.

1372.name: Farigiraf
1372.description: Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig's.

1373.name: Dudunsparce
1373.description: This Pokémon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground. The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.

1374.name: Dudunsparce
1374.description: A recent study uncovered that the number of segments a Dudunsparce's body has is determined by the Pokémon's genes.

1375.name: Kingambit
1375.description: Though it commands a massive army in battle, it's not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.

1376.name: Great Tusk
1376.description: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. The name Great Tusk was taken from a creature listed in a certain book.

1377.name: Scream Tail
1377.description: There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature depicted in an old expedition journal.

1378.name: Brute Bonnet
1378.description: It bears a slight resemblance to a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a cross between a dinosaur and a mushroom.

1379.name: Flutter Mane
1379.description: It has similar features to a ghostly pterosaur that was covered in a paranormal magazine, but the two have little else in common.

1380.name: Slither Wing
1380.description: This mysterious Pokémon has some similarities to a creature that an old book introduced as Slither Wing.

1381.name: Sandy Shocks
1381.description: It slightly resembles a Magneton that lived for 10,000 years and was featured in an article in a paranormal magazine.

1382.name: Iron Treads
1382.description: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. It resembles a mysterious object described in an old expedition journal.

1383.name: Iron Bundle
1383.description: Its shape is similar to a robot featured in a paranormal magazine article. The robot was said to have been created by an ancient civilization.

1384.name: Iron Hands
1384.description: It is very similar to a cyborg covered exclusively by a paranormal magazine. The cyborg was said to be the modified form of a certain athlete.

1385.name: Iron Jugulis
1385.description: It resembles a certain Pokémon introduced in a paranormal magazine, described as the offspring of a Hydreigon that fell in love with a robot.

1386.name: Iron Moth
1386.description: No records exist of this species being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon's traits match up with an object described in an old book.

1387.name: Iron Thorns
1387.description: It has some similarities to a Pokémon introduced in a dubious magazine as a Tyranitar from one billion years into the future.

1388.name: Frigibax
1388.description: This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.

1389.name: Arctibax
1389.description: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.

1390.name: Baxcalibur
1390.description: It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth. It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.

1391.name: Gimmighoul
1391.description: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it's actually a Pokémon.

1392.name: Gimmighoul
1392.description: It wanders around, carrying an old coin on its back. It survives by draining the life-force from humans who try to pick up its coin.

1393.name: Gholdengo
1393.description: It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.

1394.name: Wo-Chien
1394.description: The grudge of a person punished for writing the king's evil deeds upon wooden tablets has clad itself in dead leaves to become a Pokémon.

1395.name: Chien-Pao
1395.description: This Pokémon can control 100 tons of fallen snow. It plays around innocently by leaping in and out of avalanches it has caused.

1396.name: Ting-Lu
1396.description: It slowly brings its exceedingly heavy head down upon the ground, splitting the earth open with huge fissures that run over 160 feet deep.

1397.name: Chi-Yu
1397.description: It controls flames burning at over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit. It casually swims through the sea of lava it creates by melting rock and sand.

1398.name: Roaring Moon
1398.description: According to an article in a dubious magazine, this Pokémon has some connection to Mega Evolution that occurs in Hoenn.

1399.name: Iron Valiant
1399.description: It has some similarities to a mad scientist's invention covered in a paranormal magazine.

1400.name: Koraidon
1400.description: This Pokémon resembles Cyclizar, but it is far burlier and more ferocious. Nothing is known about its ecology or other features.

1401.name: Miraidon
1401.description: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an Violet Book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

1402.name: Tauros
1402.description: This Pokémon has a muscular body and excels at close-quarters combat. It uses its short horns to strike the opponent’s weak spots.

1403.name: Tauros
1403.description: When heated by fire energy, its horns can get hotter than 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. Those gored by them will suffer both wounds and burns.

1404.name: Tauros
1404.description: This Pokémon blasts water from holes on the tips of its horns--the high-pressure jets pierce right through Tauros’s enemies.

1405.name: Wooper
1405.description: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

1406.name: Walking Wake
1406.description: This ferocious creature is shrouded in mystery. It's named after an aquatic monster mentioned in an old journal.

1407.name: Iron Leaves
1407.description: According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, it used its shining blades to julienne large trees and boulders.

1408.name: Dipplin
1408.description: Dipplin is two creatures in one Pokémon. Its evolution was triggered by a special apple grown only in one place.

1409.name: Poltchageist
1409.description: Supposedly, the regrets of a tea ceremony master who died before perfecting his craft lingered in some matcha and became a Pokémon.

1410.name: Poltchageist
1410.description: It has taken up residence in a very expensive tea caddy. It takes an expert to distinguish the expensive tea caddies from the cheap ones.

1411.name: Sinistcha
1411.description: It pretends to be tea, trying to fool people into drinking it so it can drain their life-force. Its ruse is generally unsuccessful.

1412.name: Sinistcha
1412.description: The more stirring it does with the tea whisk on its head, the more energy it builds up. It does this to prepare for battle.

1413.name: Okidogi
1413.description: After all its muscles were stimulated by the toxic chain around its neck, Okidogi transformed and gained a powerful physique.

1414.name: Munkidori
1414.description: The chain is made from toxins that enhance capabilities. It stimulated Munkidori's brain and caused the Pokémon's psychic powers to bloom.

1415.name: Fezandipiti
1415.description: Fezandipiti owes its beautiful looks and lovely voice to the toxic stimulants emanating from the chain wrapped around its body.

1424.name: Ursaluna
1424.description: It crossed the sea and drifted ashore in a new land. Surviving in this place led it to take on a unique appearance and gain special powers.

1425.name: Archaludon
1425.description: It gathers static electricity from its surroundings. The beams it launches when down on all fours are tremendously powerful.

1426.name: Hydrapple
1426.description: These capricious syrpents have banded together. On the rare occasion that their moods align, their true power is unleashed.

1427.name: Gouging Fire
1427.description: There are scant few reports of this creature being sighted. One short video shows it rampaging, and spouting pillars of flame.

1428.name: Raging Bolt
1428.description: It bears resemblance to a Pokémon that became a hot topic for a short while after a paranomal magazine touted it as Raikou's ancestor.

1429.name: Iron Boulder
1429.description: It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book. Its body seems to be metallic.

1430.name: Iron Crown
1430.description: It resembles a mysterious object introduced in a paranormal magazine as a cutting-edge weapon shaped like Cobalion.

1431.name: Terapagos
1431.description: Terapagos protects itself using its power to transform energy into hard crystals. This Pokémon is the source of the Terastal phenomenon.

1432.name: Terapagos
1432.description: The shell is made of crystallized Terastal energy. When struck by a move, this shell absorbs the move's energy and transfers it to Terapagos.

1433.name: Terapagos
1433.description: An old expedition journal describes the sight of this Pokémon buried in the, depths of the earth as resembling a planet floating in space.

1434.name: Pecharunt
1434.description: It feeds others toxic mochi that draw out desires and capabilities. Those who eat the mochi fall under Pecharunt's control, chained to its will.

1476.name: Raticate
1476.description: A wild Raticate in the world.

1477.name: Gumshoos
1477.description: A wild Gumshoos in the world.

1478.name: Vikavolt
1478.description: A wild Vikavolt in the world.

1479.name: Lurantis
1479.description: A wild Lurantis in the world.

1480.name: Salazzle
1480.description: A wild Salazzle in the world.

1481.name: Mimikyu
1481.description: A wild Mimikyu in the world.

1482.name: Kommo-o
1482.description: A wild Kommo-o in the world.

1483.name: Marowak
1483.description: A wild Marowak in the world.

1484.name: Ribombee
1484.description: A wild Ribombee in the world.

1485.name: Araquanid
1485.description: A wild Araquanid in the world.

1486.name: Togedemaru
1486.description: A wild Togedemaru in the world.

1487.name: Pikachu
1487.description: A wild Pikachu in the world.

1488.name: Eevee
1488.description: A wild Eevee in the world.

1489.name: Venusaur
1489.description: Spits big amounts of pollen like a volcano. Breathing too much of it causes fainting. In battle, it swings around two thick vines that can easily topple 10-story buildings.

1490.name: Blastoise
1490.description: It's not very good at precision shooting. When attacking, it just fires its 31 cannons over and over and over.

1491.name: Charizard
1491.description: The flame inside its body burns hotter than 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit. When Charizard roars, that temperature climbs even higher.

1492.name: Butterfree
1492.description: Once it has opponents trapped in a tornado that could blow away a 10- ton truck, it finishes them off with its poisonous scales.

1493.name: Pikachu
1493.description: When it smashes its opponents with its bolt-shaped tail, it delivers a surge of electricity equivalent to a lightning strike.

1494.name: Meowth
1494.description: The pattern that has appeared on its giant coin is thought to be the key to unlocking the secrets of the Dynamax phenomenon.

1495.name: Machamp
1495.description: One of these Pokémon once used its immeasurable strength to lift a large ship that was in trouble. It then carried the ship to port.

1496.name: Gengar
1496.description: Rumor has it that its gigantic mouth leads not into its body, filled with cursed energy, but instead directly to the afterlife.

1497.name: Kingler
1497.description: The flow of Gigantamax energy has spurred this Pokémon's left pincer to grow to an enormous size. That claw can pulverize anything.

1498.name: Lapras
1498.description: Over 5,000 people can ride on its shell at once. And it's a very comfortable ride, without the slightest shaking or swaying.

1499.name: Eevee
1499.description: Having gotten even friendlier and more innocent, Eevee tries to play with anyone around, only to end up crushing them with its immense body.

1500.name: Snorlax
1500.description: Gigantamax energy has affected stray seeds and even pebbles that got stuck to Snorlax, making them grow to a huge size.

1501.name: Garbodor
1501.description: It sprays toxic gas from its mouth and fingers. If the gas engulfs you, the toxins will seep in all the way down to your bones.

1502.name: Melmetal
1502.description: In a distant land, there are legends about a cyclopean giant. In fact, the giant was a Melmetal that was flooded with Gigantamax energy.

1503.name: Rillaboom
1503.description: Rillaboom has become one with its forest of drums and continues to lay down beats that shake all of Galar.

1504.name: Cinderace
1504.description: Infused with Cinderace's fighting spirit, the gigantic Pyro Ball never misses its targets and completely roasts opponents.

1505.name: Inteleon
1505.description: Gigantamax Inteleon's Water Gun move fires at Mach 7. As the Pokémon takes aim, it uses the crest on its head to gauge wind and temperature.

1506.name: Corviknight
1506.description: Imbued with Gigantamax energy, its wings can whip up winds more forceful than any a hurricane could muster. The gusts blow everything away.

1507.name: Orbeetle
1507.description: Its brain has grown to a gargantuan size, as has the rest of its body. This Pokémon's intellect and psychic abilities are overpowering.

1508.name: Drednaw
1508.description: In the Galar region, there's a tale about this Pokémon chewing up a mountain and using the rubble to stop a flood.

1509.name: Coalossal
1509.description: Its body is a colossal stove. With Gigantamax energy stoking the fire, this Pokémon's flame burns hotter than 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

1510.name: Flapple
1510.description: Under the influence of Gigantamax energy, it produces much more sweet nectar, and its shape has changed to resemble a giant apple.

1511.name: Appletun
1511.description: Due to Gigantamax energy, this Pokémon's nectar has thickened. The increased viscosity lets the nectar absorb more damage than before.

1512.name: Sandaconda
1512.description: Its sand pouch has grown to tremendous proportions. More than 1,000,000 tons of sand now swirl around its body with enough speed and power to pulverize a skyscraper.

1513.name: Toxtricity
1513.description: A wild Toxtricity in the world.

1514.name: Toxtricity
1514.description: A wild Toxtricity in the world.

1515.name: Centiskorch
1515.description: The heat that comes off a Gigantamax Centiskorch may destabilize air currents. Sometimes it can even cause storms.

1516.name: Hatterene
1516.description: This Pokémon can read the emotions of creatures over 30 miles away. The minute it senses hostility, it goes on the attack.

1517.name: Grimmsnarl
1517.description: Gigantamax energy has caused more hair to sprout all over its body. With the added strength, it can jump over the world's tallest building.

1518.name: Alcremie
1518.description: It launches swarms of missiles, each made of cream and loaded with 100,000 kilocalories. Get hit by one of these, and your head will swim.

1519.name: Copperajah
1519.description: After this Pokémon has Gigantamaxed, its massive nose can utterly demolish large structures with a single smashing blow.

1520.name: Duraludon
1520.description: The hardness of its cells is exceptional, even among Steel types. It also has a body structure that's resistant to earthquakes.

1521.name: Urshifu
1521.description: People call it the embodiment of rage. It's said that this Pokémon's terrifying expression and shout will rid the world of malevolence.

1522.name: Urshifu
1522.description: As it waits for the right moment to unleash its Gigantamax power, this Pokémon maintains a perfect one- legged stance. It won't even twitch.

1523.name: Mimikyu
1523.description: A wild Mimikyu in the world.

1524.name: Clefable
1524.description: It flies by using the power of moonlight to control gravity within a radius of over 32 feet around it.

1525.name: Victreebel
1525.description: The volume of this Pokémon's acid has increased due to Mega Evolution, filling its mouth. If not careful, the acid will overflow and spill out.

1526.name: Starmie
1526.description: Its movements have become more humanlike. Whether it's simply trying to communicate or wants to supplant humanity is unclear.

1527.name: Dragonite
1527.description: Mega Evolution has excessively powered up this Pokémon's feelings of kindness. It finishes off its opponents with mercy in its heart.

1528.name: Meganium
1528.description: This Pokémon can fire a tremendously powerful Solar Beam from its four flowers. Another name for this is Mega Sol Cannon.

1529.name: Feraligatr
1529.description: With its arms and hoodlike fin, this Pokémon forms a gigantic set of jaws with a bite 10 times as powerful as Mega Feraligatr's actual jaws.

1530.name: Skarmory
1530.description: Due to the effects of Mega Evolution, its pincers have taken a more diabolical form, ripping anything they pierce to shreds.

1531.name: Froslass
1531.description: This Pokémon can use eerie cold air imbued with ghost energy to freeze even insubstantial things, such as flames or the wind.

1532.name: Emboar
1532.description: Brandishing a blazing flame shaped like a serpentine spear, it rushes in to save its imperiled allies.

1533.name: Excadrill
1533.description: If this Pokémon brings its arms and head together to form a streamlined shape and spins at high speeds, it can destroy anything.

1534.name: Scolipede
1534.description: Its deadly venom gives off a faint glow. The venom affects Scolipede's mind, honing its viciousness.

1535.name: Scrafty
1535.description: Mega Evolution has caused Scrafty's shed skin to turn white, growing tough and supple. Of course, this Pokémon is still as feisty as ever.

1536.name: Eelektross
1536.description: It now generates 10 times the electricity it did before Mega Evolving. It discharges this energy from its false Eelektrik made of mucus.

1537.name: Chandelure
1537.description: One of its eyes is a window linking our world with the afterlife. This Pokémon draws in hatred and converts it into power.

1538.name: Chesnaught
1538.description: It has fortified armor and a will to defend at all costs. Both are absurdly strong.

1539.name: Delphox
1539.description: It wields flaming branches to dazzle its opponents before incinerating them with a huge fireball.

1540.name: Greninja
1540.description: This Pokémon spins a giant shuriken at high speed to make it float, then clings to it upside down to catch opponents unawares.

1541.name: Pyroar
1541.description: This Pokémon spews flames hotter than 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit. It swings around its grand, blazing mane as it protects its allies.

1542.name: Malamar
1542.description: It uses its colorful lights to overwrite the personality and memories of others-and to control them.

1543.name: Dragalge
1543.description: It spits a liquid that causes the regenerative power of cells to run wild. The liquid is deadly poison to everything other than itself.

1544.name: Hawlucha
1544.description: Mega Evolution has pumped up all its muscles. Hawlucha flexes to show off its strength.

1545.name: Floette
1545.description: The Eternal Flower has absorbed all the energy from Mega Evolution. The flower now attacks enemies on its own.

1546.name: Barbaracle
1546.description: It uses its many arms to toy with its opponents. This keeps the head extremely busy.

1547.name: Zygarde
1547.description: In response to people's emotions during an unprecedented crisis, Zygarde Mega Evolves and calms the situation with its unmatched power.

1548.name: Drampa
1548.description: Drampa's cells have been invigorated, allowing it to regain its youth. It manipulates the atmosphere to summon storms.

1549.name: Falinks
1549.description: Mega Falinks has taken on the ultimate battle formation, which can be achieved only if the troopers and brass have the strongest of bonds.

1550.name: Heatran
1550.description: It's said that if it goes all out, it can heat its body up to temperatures over 1.8 million degrees Fahrenheit. This heat keeps enemies at bay.

1551.name: Darkrai
1551.description: Its dark power blocks out the sun, plunging the surrounding area into darkness. There is no escaping its evil eye.

1552.name: Zeraora
1552.description: It stores up 10 lightning strikes' worth of electricity. When it stops limiting itself, it's in the strongest class of electric Pokémon.

1553.name: Raichu
1553.description: It resembles an X as it flies through the air with 50 million volts of electricity sparking from its ears and forked tail.

1554.name: Raichu
1554.description: It fires bolts of electricity from the tip of its tail and from the spiky tufts of fur growing out of its temples. This electricity forms the letter Y.

1555.name: Chimecho
1555.description: It vibrates its entire body to attack in all directions using sound waves. Any who hear the vibrations get so confused, they forget who they are.

1556.name: Absol
1556.description: Using fur that it has made into sharp, clawlike shapes, it cuts down foes with a single blow. This is an act of kindness to keep them from suffering.

1557.name: Staraptor
1557.description: Mega Staraptor is a top-class flier. It can easily soar through the sky while gripping a Steelix that weighs more than 880 lbs.

1558.name: Garchomp
1558.description: Garchomp has gained a new Mega-Evolved form. It flies around foes at Mach speed and cuts them to shreds with its sinister wing claws.

1559.name: Lucario
1559.description: By completely cloaking itself in its aura, Mega Lucario Z can parry all manner of attacks, battling as if it were gracefully dancing.

1560.name: Golurk
1560.description: The energy within Golurk has been stimulated by Mega Evolution. The Pokémon could explode at any moment.

1561.name: Meowstic
1561.description: Mega Meowstic can use its psychic power to compress or expand anything. It overwhelms foes by contorting space itself.

1562.name: Meowstic
1562.description: Mega Meowstic can use its psychic power to compress or expand anything. It overwhelms foes by contorting space itself.

1563.name: Crabominable
1563.description: It can pulverize reinforced concrete with a light swing of one of its fists, each of which is covered in a thick layer of ice.

1564.name: Golisopod
1564.description: It uses four of its arms to fiercely assail its foes. Once they've been pushed to the brink of defeat, it finishes them off with the arms it kept hidden.

1565.name: Magearna
1565.description: This is Magearna once a previously hidden mode activates. The emotions Magearna had begun to feel now hide away as it fells foe after foe.

1566.name: Magearna
1566.description: A mechanism to remove Magearna's limitations has lain secretly within Magearna for 500 years. This mechanism is triggered by a Mega Stone.

1567.name: Scovillain
1567.description: Mega Evolution has dialed up this Pokémon's spiciness. It swings its “necktie” around to wallop its foes.

1568.name: Baxcalibur
1568.description: Baxcalibur's dorsal blade has grown even more massive thanks to Mega Evolution. This Pokémon fires beams from the hilt at its solar plexus.

1569.name: Tatsugiri
1569.description: Tatsugiri's brain has been invigorated by Mega Evolution, making it even wilier. It can create and command copies of itself.

1570.name: Tatsugiri
1570.description: It solidifies the energy of Mega Evolution, building up an overflowing pile to launch as projectiles. These projectiles explode on contact.

1571.name: Tatsugiri
1571.description: Using the energy of Mega Evolution, it creates a dish to ride upon, allowing it to move with total freedom-even through the air.

1572.name: Glimmora
1572.description: Glimmora's petals-now larger and separated from its main body-rotate around it to provide defense while cattering poisonous fragments.
